svg.aria-label: Results at a glance. Consumer memory flat at 77.2 MiB or less while reading 7M records; producer memory at most 92 MiB through a 60 s network cut; 0 records missing through a rolling restart, server peak 544 MiB after it; server memory per node from 30 MiB at 2 partitions to 1.83 GiB at 50.

text.style: font:600 11px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;letter-spacing:.06em;fill:#93A0B6
